title: Main Landing Gear Brake Assembly — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of one main landing gear brake assembly with the wheel already off, including the wear pin reading that is recorded before the unit leaves the aircraft.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of one brake assembly from a main landing gear axle. Use it for brake replacement on wear, on condition, or for access to the torque tube interface.
sections.job_setup_note: The wheel must already be removed and the aircraft on jacks or on the axle support. The brake accumulator must be discharged and the parking brake released; a charged accumulator will hold pressure in the brake for hours after the aircraft is shut down. The assembly is heavy and must be taken on the brake trolley, not by hand.
sections.procedure: WARNING: DISCHARGE THE BRAKE ACCUMULATOR AND CONFIRM ZERO PRESSURE AT THE GAUGE BEFORE YOU DISCONNECT A BRAKE LINE. THE ACCUMULATOR HOLDS PRESSURE AFTER SHUTDOWN AND WILL RELEASE FLUID AT HIGH VELOCITY. Confirm that the wheel is removed and that the aircraft is supported. Release the parking brake and discharge the accumulator, then confirm zero pressure at the gauge. Read and record the wear pin projection before you disturb the assembly. Disconnect the hydraulic line at the brake and cap both ends immediately. Disconnect the wear indication and temperature harness connectors and cap them. CAUTION: DO NOT ALLOW THE BRAKE TO HANG ON THE TORQUE TAKE-OUT ROD. SUPPORT THE ASSEMBLY ON THE TROLLEY BEFORE YOU RELEASE THE LAST FASTENER. Position the brake trolley and take the weight of the assembly. Remove the swaged collars LN606496-25 at the torque tube interface, working in the sequence of the illustration. Withdraw the brake assembly onto the trolley. Inspect the axle and the torque take-out fitting for damage and report any finding. Fit blanking caps to the open ports and cover the axle.
sections.close_out: Record the wear pin reading against the brake position and the aircraft landing count, because the wear rate trend is built from those two figures. Put the removed assembly on the trolley with its caps in place and its identification label completed. Leave the accumulator discharged until the installation task is complete.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The wear pin scale differs on the extended life heat stack; use the second table when that standard is fitted.

safety_precautions: Discharge the brake accumulator and confirm zero pressure before disconnecting a line.
Release the parking brake before you start.
Support the assembly on the trolley before releasing the last fastener.
